description: Answers "what is my RMD this year" and "when do my RMDs start": an IRA owner’s required minimum distribution from last December 31’s balance and birth year (IRS Uniform Lifetime Table, SECURE 2.0 start ages), its due date and the first RMD year. Owner accounts only; a sole-beneficiary spouse more than 10 years younger uses the Joint and Last Survivor table (Table II); inherited IRAs are not covered. Read-only.

priorYearEndBalance.description: Traditional IRA balance on December 31 of the year before, US dollars.

spouseBirthYear.description: The spouse's birth year; needed when the spouse is the sole beneficiary.

spouseSoleBeneficiary.description: The owner's spouse is the sole designated beneficiary all year. Default false.

year.description: Tax year of the distribution. Defaults to 2026, the latest year with published tables.

name: rmd

age.description: Age on the birthday in the tax year.

disclaimer.const: Not tax, legal or investment advice.

plannerLink.description: Opens the Dipperfield planner with these inputs filled in; the inputs travel in the link fragment, which browsers never send to a server.

title: Required minimum distribution
